name: ipro-agent
description: Redesign a protein toward a stated goal by the IPRO procedure, with rotamer selection as a MILP. Designing needs PyMOL from conda.

python_path.title: Python interpreter that can import pymol
python_path.description: Run `conda activate ipro-agent && which python` and paste what it prints. Don't have that environment yet? Create it first: `conda create -n ipro-agent -c conda-forge pymol-open-source python=3.12 -y && conda activate ipro-agent && pip install ipro-agent`. It has to be that environment's python, not your system one: PyMOL is conda-only, rotamers come only from its mutagenesis wizard, and this server sees only what its own interpreter can import.
